101.Name: Bountiful Rewards
101.Description: Attempt to complete a bounty quest.

1.Name: Paperless
1.Description: There's a shortage of parchment at the Arcane Library. Help them acquire enough parchment for their magic scrolls.

2.Name: Cattle Rattle
2.Description: Vicious demons have been abducting cows in middle of the night. Stand guard and protect the cattle.

3.Name: Fields of Gold
3.Description: Many crop fields were left burned by the war. Help the farmers with their recuperation efforts.

4.Name: A Helping Hand
4.Description: Help clean up the wreckage in the goldsmiths that was caused by a catastrophic explosion. Be wary of any potential explosions!

5.Name: Ogi's Request
5.Description: Ogi isn't the most agile of creatures. Help Ogi's little bird build a nest.

6.Name: Long in the Tooth
6.Description: Help the mauler tribe acquire teeth from a vicious creature, so that they can complete the crafting of their armor.

7.Name: The Befuddled Mage
7.Description: Help the Grand Mage re-arrange his library and get his books in order.

8.Name: Your Highness
8.Description: Pay a visit to the Dwarven King Asgan

9.Name: King Asgan's Ale
9.Description: You must find the finest Ale in the city and deliver it in person to the Dwarf king.

10.Name: Raw Materials
10.Description: Help the Blacksmith purchase his much needed iron ingots.

11.Name: A Precious Gift
11.Description: Help deliver precious ore to the Dwarf King

12.Name: A Beastly Tradition
12.Description: Help the mauler chieftain deliver his beast tooth necklace.

13.Name: Polluted Waters
13.Description: Water from the town's local well has acquired a peculiar taste. Go to the water's source and investigate.

14.Name: The Undead Market
14.Description: Legend has it deep within the graveyard, sacred wears are being illegally sold by an undead auctioneer. Go to the graveyard and collect intelligence.

15.Name: Nemora's Duty
15.Description: Help Nemora aid the civilians that were injured in the demonic ambush

16.Name: Celestial Crystal
16.Description: Venture into the King's Tower and retrieve the Celestial Crystal from the top floor.

17.Name: The Farmer's Orchard
17.Description: Pesky birds have been pecking at the farmer's fruit trees! Build a scarecrow to scare them away.

18.Name: Morvus' Request
18.Description: Huntin' takes its toll. Resupply Morvus with his beloved dwarven stout and gun powder.

19.Name: It's a Kinda Magic
19.Description: All sorts of new magic can be discovered by creating magic spell scrolls. Create some spells for the Arcane Library.

20.Name: Forest Expedition
20.Description: Head to the forest west of Ranhorn Keep to investigate the demon footprints.

21.Name: Gold Coating
21.Description: It's a well-known fact that coating your weapons in gold can imbue them with magical properties. Help the Kingdom with its war efforts.

22.Name: Arcane Imbuer
22.Description: Some rats have gotten into the Arcane laboratory and are starting to transform into something unusual. Deal with these rats before they get out of hand.

23.Name: Foraging
23.Description: Venture into the forest and acquire the Arcane Imbuer's much needed ingredients.

24.Name: Into the mines
24.Description: Venture into the mines and acquire gold nuggets required for the Arcane Imbuer's magical recipe.

25.Name: The Cartographer
25.Description: A local cartographer is attempting to make a new map of Esperia. Help the cartographer gather information about the surrounding areas.

26.Name: Sleepless Nights
26.Description: A restless spirit is terrorizing the local soldier's dreams. Put the spirit to rest.

27.Name: Strange Transformations
27.Description: Magical entities have started attacking travellers in the forest. Investigate and dispose of any threats.

28.Name: Wilders
28.Description: Ensure safe passage of the King's gift to the Wilders in the shady forest.

29.Name: Possessed Beasts
29.Description: Slaughter any creatures that have been possessed by evil afflictions.

30.Name: Putrid Soil
30.Description: Some of the fields are starting to stink and no crops will grow here. Go to the fields and purge the fields of any demonic curses.

31.Name: Evil Imbuer
31.Description: It seems someone has been imbuing items for evil purposes. Investigate.

32.Name: Crystal Ore
32.Description: The dwarves are renowned for their smelting skills. Venture into the mines and acquire the crystals they seek.

33.Name: Breathe Again
33.Description: The nearby trees have been afflicted by a mysterious evil. Ask the Wilders for their help, maybe they can bring back the trees.

34.Name: Deadman's Wish
34.Description: Deliver a letter found on a captain's remains to his beloved wife.

35.Name: Clear Springs
35.Description: Bless the local springs to prevent evil's encroachment

36.Name: A Message From the Wild
36.Description: Deliver a leaf from the world tree to Arden.

37.Name: Limitless Knowledge
37.Description: Attend a class at the Arcane Library.

38.Name: Insipid Evil
38.Description: A mysterious evil spirit has been eroding the wildlife surrounding Ranhorn Keep. Cleanse this land of any evil spirits.

39.Name: Stale Ale
39.Description: There has been strange happenings at the local tavern. Investigate to see if the tavern is haunted.

40.Name: Gloomy Forest
40.Description: A once friendly beast become enraged. Deal with this beast and investigate what caused his unusual transformation.

41.Name: Legendary Anvil
41.Description: Search deep within the abyssal caverns for the legendary anvil and present it as a gift to King Asgan of the dwarves.

42.Name: Wild Wisdom
42.Description: Talk to the Mauler's chieftain to discover more about their magical ways.

43.Name: Nemora's Request
43.Description: Help Nemora exorcise a spirit that has been haunting the locals.

44.Name: Undead Research
44.Description: Research the Graveborn's biology and ascertain what their weaknesses are.

45.Name: Angelo's Request
45.Description: Accompany and protect Angelo as he makes his way to the frontlines.

46.Name: Morvus' Nemesis
46.Description: Help Morvus slay his old nemesis, the great grizzly that has risen from the dead.

47.Name: Arden's Resolve
47.Description: Help Arden research a way to stop the demon's magical attacks on the empire

48.Name: Overcome the Sleeping Evil
48.Description: Demonic spirits are adept at hiding themselves. Destroy any graves you suspect are home to dormant evils.

49.Name: Deluge
49.Description: Go underground and investigate the strange ritual that is said to take place.

50.Name: Wrazer
50.Description: Destroy the wandering evil apparition known as Wrazer

51.Name: The Following
51.Description: Vanquish all followers of the demonic occult

52.Name: Arcane Danger
52.Description: Something has gone awry at the imbuing labs. Imps have manifested themselves and must be dealt with swiftly.

53.Name: Holy Defence
53.Description: Purge the sacred shrine of any apparitions within the gloomy forest

54.Name: Retribution
54.Description: The tyrannical rulers of the old empire has been increased from the dead to terrorize the world once more. Lift the curse and lay him to rest.

55.Name: Ogi's Rage
55.Description: Help Ogi defeat the demons in the forest that are pestering him.

56.Name: Bones
56.Description: A skeletal army was seen moving through the gloomy forest. Co-ordinate an ambush and stop them.

57.Name: Spellbook
57.Description: Retrieve the Arcane Librarian's spellbook that was dropped in his hasty retreat from the Graveborn.

58.Name: Corrupted Wilder
58.Description: Deal with the Wilder who has been corrupted by evil.

59.Name: Ruffian
59.Description: A Mauler has succumb to the temptations of evil. Lay him to rest.

60.Name: Ring of Wisdom
60.Description: Find and return the Ring of Wisdom to it's rightful owner.

61.Name: The Following
61.Description: Vanquish all followers of the demonic occult

62.Name: Arcane Danger
62.Description: Something has gone awry at the imbuing labs. Imps have manifested themselves and must be dealt with swiftly.

63.Name: Holy Defence
63.Description: Purge the sacred shrine of any apparitions within the gloomy forest

64.Name: Retribution
64.Description: The tyrannical rulers of the old empire has been increased from the dead to terrorize the world once more. Lift the curse and lay him to rest.

65.Name: Ogi's Rage
65.Description: Help Ogi defeat the demons in the forest that are pestering him.

66.Name: Bones
66.Description: A skeletal army was seen moving through the gloomy forest. Co-ordinate an ambush and stop them.

67.Name: Spellbook
67.Description: Retrieve the Arcane Librarian's spellbook that was dropped in his hasty retreat from the Graveborn.

68.Name: Corrupted Wilder
68.Description: Deal with the Wilder who has been corrupted by evil.

69.Name: Ruffian
69.Description: A Mauler has succumb to the temptations of evil. Lay him to rest.

70.Name: Ring of Wisdom
70.Description: Find and return the Ring of Wisdom to it's rightful owner.

1001.Name: Munitions Order
1001.Description: Help Commander Hogan deliver his munitions order to the local blacksmith so that he can replenish his army's weaponry.

1002.Name: Hard Times
1002.Description: The citizens of Ranhorn are without food and water,and are on the brink of death. Deliver rations to the city to help its citizens.

1003.Name: Toll the Bell
1003.Description: Toll the bell in Ranhorn's cathedral to inform its citizens of the Hypogean invasion.

1004.Name: Unstable Elements
1004.Description: Something is afoot within the Bastion of the Elements. Go and investigate.

1005.Name: Unfinished Business
1005.Description: Several spirits have been wandering around the graveyard. Exorcise the graveyard and expel the spirits.

1006.Name: Vile Vials
1006.Description: Numisu requires several vials of venom to begin his sacrificial ceremony. Acquire venom and give it to Numisu.

1007.Name: On Patrol
1007.Description: The Dusk Patrollers are too busy fighting the Hypogean invaders to perform their regular patrols within the forest. Help them patrol the forest and ensure nothing is amiss.

1008.Name: Needed Repairs
1008.Description: Several of the Maulers' fortifications have been damaged by the invaders. Help the Maulers repair their fortifications.

1009.Name: Blasted Bandits
1009.Description: A group of cunning bandits has made off with gold from Ranhorn's royal reserve. Seek out the bandits and bring them to justice.

1010.Name: Entangled
1010.Description: Deadly vines are choking the life out of all other flora in the forest. Go to the forest and hack down the vines.

1011.Name: Pestilence
1011.Description: An unknown disease is spreading throughout the city with terrifying speed, causing its citizens to fall ill and die. Help the city's maesters research a cure.

1012.Name: Shelter
1012.Description: Hunt down wild oxen and harvest their skin so that the Maulers can repair their tents.

1013.Name: Boneless
1013.Description: Help Vedan harvest the bones of the dead for his experiments.

1014.Name: Special Specimens
1014.Description: Seek out some rare plant specimens deep within forest so that the Wilders' botanists can research them for their medicine.

1015.Name: Neverending Nightmare
1015.Description: A poor spirit has been tormented by nightmares of his death everyday. Use divine magic to relieve the poor spirit of his nightmares.

1016.Name: Liberation
1016.Description: Gladiators within the arena are being kept as slaves by an evil slavemaster. Kill the slavemaster and liberate his gladiators.

1017.Name: Rebuilding the Mill
1017.Description: The mill within the town of Woolhope was burned to a cinder by the demon invaders. Help the townsfolk rebuild their mill.

1018.Name: Rotten Bark
1018.Description: Trees within the forest are being affected by the barred gate's demonic magic and are starting to rot. Set up a forcefield around the trees to protect.

1019.Name: Hunter's Glory
1019.Description: The Maulers are holding a contest. The hunter with the most dangerous prey wins the contest. Enter the contest.

1020.Name: Forever Young
1020.Description: Although the Graveborn are already dead, their bodies can still deteriorate. Seek out some embalming oil to help them preserve their bodies.

1021.Name: Safe Passage
1021.Description: Travelling merchants are unable to pass through Esperia safely. Escort them safely to their destination.

1022.Name: Taming the Beast
1022.Description: Iron-jaws make great mounts. They are extremely powerful and very loyal. Tame an Iron-jaw to use as a mount.

1023.Name: War Horses
1023.Description: Help the cavalrymen ready their war horses before they head off to war.

1024.Name: Hooligans
1024.Description: A gang of drunk hooligans have arrived at one of Ranhorn's taverns and are causing trouble. Help the tavern owner throw out the hooligans.

1025.Name: Out of Control
1025.Description: Several Graveborn are causing havoc in the local graveyard. Go to the graveyard and deal with them.

1026.Name: In-fighting
1026.Description: Fighting has broken out between the Centaurs and Bears of the Mauler faction. Use diplomacy to help mediate the dispute.

1027.Name: Migration
1027.Description: Wildlife is fleeing from the demon invaders at the edge of the forest. Go to the edge of the forest and help them migrate safely away from the invaders.

1028.Name: Scattered Embers
1028.Description: For some unknown reason, many elemental creatures have been disappearing, leaving only mounds of dust and embers on the ground where they stood. Investigate the cause of their disappearances.

1029.Name: Prisoners of War
1029.Description: The Hypogeans have captured several Wilders, subjecting them to severe torture. Liberate the Wilders from their wicked captors.

1030.Name: Essential Materials
1030.Description: Scavenge animal bones so that Vedan can use them in his necromancy ritual.

1031.Name: Double Agent
1031.Description: Intelligence from the Lightbearer's royal army is being leaked to the enemy. Seek out the perpetrator and deal with them appropriately.

1032.Name: Gunpowder Plot
1032.Description: The Royal Dwarven Marksmen require gunpowder for their muskets. Bring some to their encampment.

1033.Name: Voodoo Magic
1033.Description: The Mauler witch doctors require a crucible in order to prepare their venomous vials. Seek out a crucible and give it to Numisu.

1034.Name: In the Shade
1034.Description: Graveborn are unable to stay outside in direct sunlight for too long. Bring a large leather tent to Thoran and Grezhul so that they can rest peacefully.

1035.Name: A Grave Warning
1035.Description: Several human bandits are desecrating the local cemetery. Ward them off before they anger Graveborn resting within.

1036.Name: Source of Corruption
1036.Description: Arden can smell a putrid stench wafting throughout the forest. Accompany him to investigate the source of the smell.

1037.Name: Beacon Towers
1037.Description: Several of the smoke beacons atop the mountain peaks are in disrepair. Climb the mountains and help the dwarves repair them so they can send a warning if the Hypogeans attack.

1038.Name: Toxic Spores
1038.Description: Toxic fungi is beginning to overgrow other flora in the dark forest. Help Ulmus and Tasi stop the overgrowth.

1039.Name: Nefarious Spirits
1039.Description: One of the local townsfolk is being tormented by a nefarious spirit. Help them drive off the mischievous poltergeist.

1040.Name: An Encroaching Danger
1040.Description: Hypogeans have been seen advancing on Mauler territory. Set off the smoke beacons to let the Mauler tribes know of the encroaching danger.

1041.Name: Piracy
1041.Description: Pirates regularly plunder and pillage the poor folk of Gull's Wharf. It's time to put a final stop to their plundering. Wait for the pirates to attack and end their criminal ways.

1042.Name: Collapsed Mine
1042.Description: One of the dwarven mines has collapsed in on itself, trapping several dwarven miners. Assemble a rescue team and free them from the mine.

1043.Name: Hungry Beast
1043.Description: Help Skreg scavenge for food to feed his Iron-jaw mount.

1044.Name: Missing Citizens
1044.Description: There have been reports of drunk folk going missing after leaving taverns late at night. Investigate their whereabouts and find the source of their disappearances.

1045.Name: One Man's Trash
1045.Description: One man's trash is another's treasure. Help the Graveborn scavenge old and discarded weaponry that the Lightbearers no longer want.

1046.Name: Cleansing Totem
1046.Description: Help Numisu set down several of his cleansing totems to rid the surrounding Mauler encampments of any demonic evil that may be present.

1047.Name: A Tribute To Dura
1047.Description: The Wilders want to perform ceremony for the goddess Dura. Help them find some suitable items to be used as an offering.

1048.Name: Strengthening The Defenses
1048.Description: The protective forcefield protecting the Wilders' home has been weakened by constant Hypogean attacks. Help Arden and Nemora strengthen the magical forcefield by performing a protection spell.

1049.Name: Healing Herbs
1049.Description: Search within the forests and gather some medicinal herbs to help the injured Wilders recover more quickly.

1050.Name: A Missing Arm
1050.Description: A Graveborn skeletal warrior has lost one of his arms. Help him find his boney limb so it can be reattached.

1051.Name: Bootcamp
1051.Description: Help the Royal Army train up new recruits that can be used to fight off the demon invaders.

1052.Name: Scattered Goods
1052.Description: A merchant ship has become shipwrecked upon the rocks of the emerald coast. Help them recover their scattered goods that have washed up on shore.

1053.Name: Demon's Horn
1053.Description: Kill and extract a demon's horn so that it can be used by Vedan in one of his arcane rituals.

1054.Name: Desecration
1054.Description: Graveborn warriors are dwindling. Help the Graveborn army by digging up the graves of the dead so that they may be used to bolster their army.

1055.Name: Free Spirits
1055.Description: Several Graveborn have been imprisoned inside a divine cube. Free them of their prison.

1056.Name: Frozen Goods
1056.Description: Travel into the white woods to acquire some crystal ore that can be used to forge powerful weapons for the Maulers' heroes.

1057.Name: Quenched
1057.Description: It hasn't rained for a long time in the dark forest. Help Nemora bring water from the local stream to water the withering flora in the forest.

1058.Name: Natural Danger
1058.Description: Gather some vines to set up traps within the forest to trap any invading Hypogeans.

1059.Name: Dark Enchantments
1059.Description: Enchant your fellow Graveborn's weaponry with dark magic to help them fight more efficiently in battle.

1060.Name: Home-made Explosives
1060.Description: The dwarves want to blow up part of a mountain side. Assist them with laying explosive charges on the mountain.

1061.Name: Bootcamp
1061.Description: Help the Royal Army train up new recruits that can be used to fight off the demon invaders.
